packages.title: City map
packages.summary: Downloads the roundabouts of the area the car is in (OpenStreetMap; all of Switzerland) and tells, for every roundabout driven, where it was entered and which exit was taken, and predicts the exit from the navigation's next turn. Read only; the position never leaves the car.

manifest.title: City map
manifest.summary: Downloads the roundabouts of the area the car is in (OpenStreetMap; all of Switzerland) and tells, for every roundabout driven, where it was entered and which exit was taken, and predicts the exit from the navigation's next turn. Read only; the position never leaves the car.

settings.title: Download request
settings.summary: Set by the Download button in the panel; any new value downloads the map of the city the car is in.

packages.title: DriveLogger
packages.summary: Logs every drive and charge by itself in the car, offline: route, speed, battery, power, recuperation and FSD every second; per drive addresses, km, time, speeds, FSD and recuperation in km and %; charges AC/DC with place and curve. App in the launcher.

manifest.title: DriveLogger
manifest.summary: Logs every drive and charge by itself in the car, offline: route, speed, battery, power, recuperation and FSD every second; per drive addresses, km, time, speeds, FSD and recuperation in km and %; charges AC/DC with place and curve. App in the launcher.

packages.title: DataValue list
packages.summary: A web page with every DataValue the car's UI knows and its current value, refreshed every minute (no filter: every name in the UI's files is tried once per start), and a log of every drive (a row every 2 s), served only on the car's Tailscale address (read only).

manifest.title: DataValue list
manifest.summary: A web page with every DataValue the car's UI knows and its current value, refreshed every minute (no filter: every name in the UI's files is tried once per start), and a log of every drive (a row every 2 s), served only on the car's Tailscale address (read only).

settings.title: Port
settings.summary: TCP port on the car's Tailscale address.

packages.title: Energy card
packages.summary: Live power and recuperation, and energy, consumption, distance and time for this trip and since the last charge, and how much came back by recuperation, in one card: a card slot when the car offers one, else over the map.

manifest.title: Energy card
manifest.summary: Live power and recuperation, and energy, consumption, distance and time for this trip and since the last charge, and how much came back by recuperation, in one card: a card slot when the car offers one, else over the map.

settings.title: New trip after parked for
settings.summary: A stop shorter than this continues the trip.

settings.title: Where the card goes
settings.summary: Auto: a card slot when the car offers one, else over the map.

settings.title: Bar style
settings.summary: text: a bar of block characters. drawn: experimental, a drawn green/white bar; if the card disappears, switch back to text.

settings.title: Start folded
settings.summary: Start as the small box with an arrow.

settings.title: Card position
settings.summary: Top or bottom of the map, on the side of Corner. Also the arrow button on the card.

settings.title: Distance from the bottom
settings.summary: Space below the card when it sits at the bottom (the car's own buttons and the street name are there).

settings.title: Card folded
settings.summary: The card folded to a small box with an arrow in its corner. Also the Fold button in the Energy card panel, and a tap on the card when Tap to fold is on.

settings.title: Tap to fold
settings.summary: A tap on the down arrow folds the card to a small up-arrow button, a tap on that opens it. Off: every touch goes through to the map and the arrow is hidden.

settings.title: Corner
settings.summary: Where the card sits over the map. On the right a Model 3 or Y keeps 120 px more distance from the edge, clear of the map buttons and the navigation.

settings.title: Distance from the edge
settings.summary: From the right edge when the corner is right, else from the left edge.

settings.title: Full bar at
settings.summary: Power at which the bar is full, each side.

settings.title: Invert the power sign
settings.summary: Turn on if recuperation shows as consumption.

settings.title: Power DataValue (kW)
settings.summary: Empty: the service looks for the pack's power. VOLTAGE*CURRENT (two names) is their product in kW. Easiest set with Use under Live values.

settings.title: Battery level DataValue (%)
settings.summary: Empty: tried by name. Used to notice a charge.

packages.title: Enhanced dashcam
packages.summary: Records the camera streams the normal dashcam leaves out (the front bumper camera), next to it and in its format: one clip a minute in RecentClips, same names and metadata. A button over the map starts and stops it.

manifest.title: Enhanced dashcam
manifest.summary: Records the camera streams the normal dashcam leaves out (the front bumper camera), next to it and in its format: one clip a minute in RecentClips, same names and metadata. A button over the map starts and stops it.

settings.title: Extra camera streams
settings.summary: name:port of each stream recorded beside the normal dashcam (multicast 224.0.0.155). The name ends up in the clip's file name.

settings.title: Keep free on the USB drive
settings.summary: No extra clip is written while less than this is free, so the normal dashcam never runs out of space because of this package.

settings.title: Button top (Y)
settings.summary: Default: just above the Speed profile menu (which sits at 670).

packages.title: Speed profile
packages.summary: Speed profile buttons in a panel under the navi card and a clear vertical speed bar beside it: the FSD speed with -5/-1/+1/+5 (the car's own set-speed request, never above limit + 50 %) and every speed limit the car knows; placement adjustable in its settings panel.

manifest.title: Speed profile
